dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: Are you talking about that potion we sprinkled around the last time?

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: Hmm... Ladep and Pharez are still trying to make adjustments.

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: The effect was good indeed, but the "physiolocial emetic" that Ladep added really made other people quite uncomfortable.

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: And I don't know why, but this potion also attracts Fungi.

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: I hope Ladep can come up with an improved formula soon...
